cfg.title: Configuration
cfg.hint.liveVsRestart: Most settings apply immediately after saving. Already-loaded models keep their previous settings until reloaded. Only host/port require a full service restart.
cfg.hint.defaultServeArgs: Fallback values for models without their own override below.
cfg.hint.extraArgs: One flag/value per line, e.g. --foo then bar on the next line.
cfg.field.gpuMemoryCeiling: GPU memory ceiling (sum of all engines)
cfg.field.defaultModel: Default model (used when a request has no "model")
cfg.field.autoReloadLastModel: Auto-reload last used model on service restart
cfg.hint.pricing: Fictional prices for cost comparison (see the Costs page) - default is standard Claude Sonnet 5 pricing. Purely informational, no effect on actual (free) local operation. Per-model overrides are set on each model below.
cfg.field.maxTokens: Max output tokens (safety net, empty = unbounded)
cfg.hint.maxTokens: Caps generation length only when the client itself doesn't request a max_tokens value - protects against runaway/repeating generations without limiting normal replies.
cfg.status.detectNotCached: Model not cached locally - nothing to detect from yet.
cfg.hint.detectDisclaimer: Best-effort guess from the model's own chat template - always double-check before relying on it.
cfg.status.restartRequired: host/port changed - takes effect only after a service restart.
cfg.status.restarting: Restart triggered - service will be briefly unavailable…
cfg.status.restartTimeout: No response yet - check manually: sudo journalctl -u vllm -f
cfg.status.duplicateModel: Duplicate model name "{model}" - rename one of them before saving.
confirm.restartService: Restart the vLLM Manager service now? Active connections will briefly drop.
confirm.restoreBackup: Restore backup "{name}"? This overwrites the current configuration (a fresh backup of the current state is made first).
cost.title: Cost Tracking
cost.disclaimer: Purely fictional cost comparison: the local model runs for free - this estimates what the same tokens would have cost via the Claude Sonnet 5 API, for reference. Adjust rates per model in the Config Editor.
cost.hint.pricedRequests: Requests without exact token usage show no cost
cost.hint.noUsage: No exact token usage for this request (e.g. streaming without stream_options.include_usage) - no cost shown
cost.hint.soFarOutputOnly: Live estimate from streamed tokens so far - output only, prompt cost not yet known
cost.confirm.resetAll: Delete ALL cost records? This cannot be undone.
help.poolBudget.title: Pool Memory Budget
help.poolBudget.body: Shows how much of the configured GPU memory budget (gpu_memory_ceiling) is currently claimed by all loaded models together - the SUM of each engine's gpu_memory_utilization value, not a live measurement of actual memory usage. If loading a new model would exceed this limit, the longest-idle model is automatically evicted (unless it currently has an active request).
help.kvCache.title: KV Cache
help.kvCache.body: How full this engine's KV cache (key-value cache) currently is - the memory where the model keeps track of every token in the context while generating. Comes directly from vLLM's own metrics. As this approaches 100%, vLLM can no longer accept new requests immediately and has to queue them.
help.avgTtft.title: Avg TTFT (Engine)
help.avgTtft.body: Average Time-To-First-Token of this engine across all requests it has served so far: the time from a request arriving at the engine to the first generated token (prompt processing). Comes directly from vLLM's own metrics, not calculated by this dashboard.
help.avgMsPerTok.title: Avg ms/Tok (Engine)
help.avgMsPerTok.body: Average time per generated token (time-per-output-token) across all requests this engine has served so far - the inverse of tokens/second generation speed. Comes directly from vLLM's own metrics.
help.tokensPromptGen.title: Tokens (Prompt/Gen.)
help.tokensPromptGen.body: Total number of prompt tokens processed / tokens generated by this engine since it started - summed across ALL requests it has served, not just the most recent one. Comes directly from vLLM's own counters and resets when the engine is unloaded.
help.requestsEngine.title: Requests (Running/Waiting)
help.requestsEngine.body: How many requests this engine is actively processing right now (running) vs. waiting for free capacity (waiting) - vLLM's own request queue, taken directly from its metrics. Thanks to continuous batching, several requests can be "running" at the same time.
help.phase.title: Phase
help.phase.body: What the model is currently doing for this request: 🥶 still loading (cold start) → ⏳ processing the prompt (no output yet) → 💭 thinking (reasoning models) / 🔧 calling a tool / ✍️ generating the answer. "since Xs" shows how long the current phase has been running. Hover the badge to see a timeline of all phase changes so far.
help.loadTime.title: Load Time
help.loadTime.body: How long this request had to wait until the requested model was ready - e.g. because of a cold start, or because another model first had to be evicted to make room. Close to 0 if the model was already warm.
help.ttft.title: TTFT
help.ttft.body: Time-To-First-Token: the time from "model ready" to the first generated token of this specific request - pure prompt-processing time, not including any load time.
help.liveTokens.title: Live Tokens
help.liveTokens.body: Prompt / generated tokens for this one running request. The generated-side count is live but approximate (1 streamed chunk with content ≈ 1 token, not an exact tokenizer count) and also shown split out separately for thinking/reasoning tokens (only if the model has a reasoning_parser configured - see the Config Editor). The prompt side shows "–" until vLLM reports it - which only happens mid-stream if the client sent stream_options.include_usage, otherwise it becomes known only once the request finishes.
help.throughput.title: Throughput
help.throughput.body: Current generation speed of this running request in tokens per second, calculated live from the tokens streamed so far since the answer started (after load time/prompt processing).
help.cost.title: Cost
help.cost.body: Purely fictional comparison value: what these tokens would have cost via a cloud API (default: Claude Sonnet 5 pricing, adjustable per model in the Config Editor). Local operation is and remains free - see the dedicated Costs page (💰 Costs) for details, history, and pricing configuration.
help.requestTokens.title: Prompt/Completion Tokens
help.requestTokens.body: Exact prompt/completion token counts for this one completed request (not cumulative like "Tokens (Prompt/Gen.)" in the Loaded Models table). Only available if the response included a usage field - for streaming requests without stream_options.include_usage this stays empty.
help.ramUnified.title: RAM Usage (Unified Memory)
help.ramUnified.body: On this hardware (Grace Blackwell / GB10), CPU and GPU share the same physical memory (unified memory) - so RAM usage here also covers the memory needs of loaded models. There's no separate VRAM display on this system.
